q-128432.name: Question 1
q-128432.worked_solution:
We have to divide a negative number $(-13)$ by another negative number $(-5).$ So the result will be positive:

$$
(-13)÷(-5)=\boxed{}
$$

Now, to compute the number that goes in the box, we divide $13$ by $5$ without any signs: $13÷5=\frac{13}{5}.$ Therefore,  we get

$$
(-13)÷(-5)=\frac{13}{5}.
$$
